description: This file implements the StreamConsumerExtension class in the Orleans streaming infrastructure, handling stream subscription management, message delivery, and logging within the Orleans runtime. It includes methods for setting observers, delivering items and batches, handling stream completion and errors, and managing internal subscription handles.

classes.name: StreamConsumerExtension
classes.description: Sealed class implementing IStreamConsumerExtension to handle stream subscription, message delivery, and observer management within the Orleans streaming infrastructure.

methods.name: SetObserver
methods.description: Sets up a new stream subscription with specified observer and batch observer, associated with a particular stream and subscription ID.

methods.name: RemoveObserver
methods.description: Removes a stream subscription observer based on subscription ID.

methods.name: DeliverImmutable
methods.description: Delivers an immutable stream item to the specified subscription.

methods.name: DeliverMutable
methods.description: Delivers a mutable stream item to the specified subscription, with logging and fallback to handle observer absence.

methods.name: DeliverBatch
methods.description: Delivers a batch of stream items to the specified subscription, with logging and fallback handling.

methods.name: CompleteStream
methods.description: Signals completion of the stream subscription.

methods.name: ErrorInStream
methods.description: Signals an error encountered during stream processing.

methods.name: GetSequenceToken
methods.description: Retrieves the sequence token for a subscription.
